brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Vanuatu has signed a declaration to give children and youth a greater voice on climate. [2]
Vanuatu came together to honour 45 lives lost at sea in recent weeks. [3][5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR VANUATU
The signing of the declaration to give youth a greater voice on climate signals Vanuatu's commitment to climate action, despite having a net energy import dependency of 0%. [2][E3]

KEY RISKS
Vanuatu's link to 2 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a risk of financial and reputational repercussions. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The resolution of trade union concerns over the education essential service designation remains unresolved. [4]
